status: TEMPLATE 2026-10-15 (copy, fill every <...> field, then freeze with dbench.translational.write_survival_spec BEFORE any outcome is loaded; the frozen record's sha256 is the registration)
purpose: ajas.md 'Clinical claims': one pre-specified clinically relevant endpoint for the strongest H&E-distilled or directly measurable discovery; the score counts clinically only if it adds information beyond stage, grade and the other essential clinicopathological variables

cohort.name: <e.g. cptac_ccrcc | tcga_kirc>
cohort.inclusion: <e.g. primary tumour, one slide per patient, finite score and covariates, time > 0>
cohort.score_source: <H&E student slide score (dbench/scripts/he_student.py output path + sha256) or measured score>

covariate_coding.stage: ordinal I-IV as numeric (missing -> patient excluded, count reported)
covariate_coding.grade: ordinal 1-4 as numeric; where the cohort has no grade it is listed under covariates_unavailable, never imputed

model_definition: dbench.translational.fit_cox_tertiles: Cox proportional hazards (statsmodels PHReg, Efron ties), covariates alone vs covariates + score tertile dummies (low = reference); tertile cuts from the cohort's own score distribution
primary_metric_definition: likelihood-ratio test of the two tertile terms (chi2, df 2) and the incremental Harrell C (covariates + tertiles minus covariates) with a percentile bootstrap interval (both models refit per resample, n_boot 200, seed fixed below); calibration of the full model reported beside it
direction: <higher score -> higher hazard | higher score -> lower hazard> (stated before fitting; a significant effect in the other direction is reported as such, not as support)
frozen_candidates_sha256: <sha256 of the frozen list of scores entering the test (one per discovery; the family size enters the BH adjustment)>
multiplicity: BH across the frozen candidates (run_predeclared_survival's bh_q_family)
decision_rule: a stronger clinical claim only if the LRT p (BH q across the frozen family) <= 0.05 AND the incremental-C bootstrap interval excludes 0, in the stated direction; otherwise the biological / translational result stands and no further endpoint is tried
not_allowed: choosing the endpoint after looking at outcomes
adding or dropping covariates after fitting
